description: Strict testcase-node JUnit outcome parsing and report-specific suite identity.

cases.description: A failure node cannot be hidden by a suite declaring zero failures.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="same" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="fails"><failure message="bad"/></testcase></testsuite>

cases.description: An error node cannot be hidden by a suite declaring zero errors.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="same" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="errors"><error message="bad"/></testcase></testsuite>

cases.description: A skipped node cannot be hidden by a suite declaring zero skips.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="same" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="skipped"><skipped/></testcase></testsuite>

cases.description: Declared test totals must equal actual testcase nodes.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="parameterized" tests="3" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="case[0]"/><testcase name="case[1]"/></testsuite>

cases.description: Parent testsuites totals must reconcile with child testcase outcomes.
cases.xml: <testsuites tests="2" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testsuite name="suite" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="one"/></testsuite></testsuites>

cases.description: Equal suite names from distinct task/device report paths retain separate identities.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="same" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="case[0]"/></testsuite>
cases.related_xml: <testsuite name="same" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="case[1]"/></testsuite>

cases.description: Valid parameterized testcase nodes are counted individually.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="parameterized" tests="2" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="case[0]"/><testcase name="case[1]"/></testsuite>

cases.description: A nested suite cannot hide a failed testcase from direct-child totals.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="outer" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="visible-pass"/><testsuite name="inner" tests="1" failures="1" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="hidden-failure"><failure/></testcase></testsuite></testsuite>

cases.description: A nested suite cannot hide an errored testcase from direct-child totals.
cases.xml: <testsuites tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testsuite name="outer" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="visible-pass"/><testsuite name="inner" tests="1" failures="0" errors="1" skipped="0"><testcase name="hidden-error"><error/></testcase></testsuite></testsuite></testsuites>

cases.description: A nested suite cannot hide a skipped testcase from direct-child totals.
cases.xml: <testsuites tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testsuite name="outer" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="visible-pass"/><testsuite name="inner" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="1"><testcase name="hidden-skip"><skipped/></testcase></testsuite></testsuite></testsuites>

cases.description: A testcase hidden below an unsupported wrapper cannot be omitted.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="wrapped" tests="0" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><wrapper><testcase name="hidden"><failure/></testcase></wrapper></testsuite>
cases.expected_error: testcase elements outside its direct children

cases.description: An orphan failed testcase under testsuites cannot be omitted beside a valid suite.
cases.xml: <testsuites tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testsuite name="visible" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="pass"/></testsuite><testcase name="orphan"><failure/></testcase></testsuites>

cases.description: An orphan errored testcase under testsuites cannot be omitted beside a valid suite.
cases.xml: <testsuites tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testsuite name="visible" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="pass"/></testsuite><testcase name="orphan"><error/></testcase></testsuites>

cases.description: An orphan skipped testcase under testsuites cannot be omitted beside a valid suite.
cases.xml: <testsuites tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testsuite name="visible" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="pass"/></testsuite><testcase name="orphan"><skipped/></testcase></testsuites>

cases.description: A failure below a testcase wrapper cannot be counted as a pass.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="wrapped" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="case"><wrapper><failure/></wrapper></testcase></testsuite>

cases.description: An error below a testcase wrapper cannot be counted as a pass.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="wrapped" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="case"><wrapper><error/></wrapper></testcase></testsuite>

cases.description: A skip below a testcase wrapper cannot be counted as a pass.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="wrapped" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="case"><wrapper><skipped/></wrapper></testcase></testsuite>

cases.description: A failure in an unsupported namespace cannot be ignored as a successful testcase.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="namespace" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="case"><failure xmlns="urn:unrecognized"/></testcase></testsuite>

cases.description: An error in an unsupported namespace cannot be ignored as a successful testcase.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="namespace" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="case"><error xmlns="urn:unrecognized"/></testcase></testsuite>

cases.description: A skip in an unsupported namespace cannot be ignored as a successful testcase.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="namespace" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="case"><skipped xmlns="urn:unrecognized"/></testcase></testsuite>

cases.description: Supported suite properties and system output text remain valid while testcase totals reconcile exactly.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="supported" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><properties><property name="runner" value="gradle"/></properties><testcase name="pass"/><system-out>ordinary test output</system-out><system-err>ordinary diagnostic output</system-err></testsuite>
